M6.2 earthquake off central Chile coast (1,200km south of loading port). No damage to port infrastructure reported. Tsunami warning cancelled.

Andean seismic activity elevated in May-June window. Mining operations in Antofagasta region operating normally but earthquake protocols active.
El Niño transition year; elevated risk of Pacific storm activity along South America→Asia shipping lane in Q3.
